data.body:
rebar-debug final repair report.

Problem: rebar emitted ambiguous `openai:` Pydantic-AI model targets; Pydantic AI 1.107.2 warns that v2 changes that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses.

Proven root cause/proof: `_pai_model` and model-class `_resolve_target` preserved/emitted `openai:`. Runtime `infer_model` under warning-as-error produced `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning`; replacing the target with `openai-chat:` constructed `OpenAIChatModel` without warning. The cfg.base_url builder-registration and per-candidate endpoint-override gates also matched only the legacy provider name, so the explicit target needed parity there.

Test: the final held-out oracle in `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py` covered inferred `gpt-4o` + provider `openai`, legacy explicit `openai:gpt-4o`, and model-class target resolution. It was RED first (3 failures), was absent from the blind fixer’s worktree, then GREEN. Reintroducing the exact old `openai:` output in both production seams returned all three cases to RED (two deprecation failures plus the target assertion); restoring the fix returned them to GREEN.

Fix: inferred and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets normalize to `openai-chat:` across primary, model-class, and fallback resolution; custom base URL and per-candidate endpoint builders accept that explicit qualifier; documentation examples now recommend it. Other provider targets are unchanged. This implements the user-approved Chat Completions contract.

Scope/safety: caller sweep covered direct runner resolution, model-class/fallback composition, cfg.base_url, and candidate endpoint override. The change freezes existing wire semantics, creates no new capability or dependency, and weakens no test. Provider/warning matrix: 244 passed with `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning` promoted to error. Original provider reproduction: 13 passed with that warning promoted to error. Broader unit/interface sweep, lint, typecheck, complexity, formatting, and diff checks pass.

Siblings/parity: all live target-construction seams were normalized. Current eval-spec grader `openai:` strings are report-only: `run_eval` executes deterministic scorers and does not construct those models, so they are not live siblings. CLI/library/workflow callers converge on the repaired shared resolver/session.

Residual risk/prevention: migration to OpenAI Responses is intentionally out of scope and tracked by `upbeat-illadvised-springtail` (`155c-218b-c128-4700`), per user approval. Report-only eval grader strings remain accepted as inert metadata until that story owns migration.

Replication: both inferred and legacy-explicit OpenAI paths now build `OpenAIChatModel` through the real Pydantic-AI inference boundary without the announced-v2 deprecation.
